name: parallax
description: Ask Claude, GPT, Gemini, OpenRouter and local models the same question side by side, or have them discuss it, with your own API keys.
long_description:
Parallax sends one prompt to several AI models in parallel and brings every answer back, or runs a group discussion where the models take turns replying to each other.

It works with Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, xAI, DeepSeek, Groq, Mistral, Together AI, Ollama, LM Studio and any OpenAI-compatible server. Enter keys in this extension's settings, or ask Claude to run **configure_keys**, which opens a page in your browser for the other providers. Keys stay on your computer and are only sent to their provider.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Show the providers and models Parallax can use with your keys.

tools.name: ask_models
tools.description: Send one prompt to several models at once and get every answer back.

tools.name: group_discussion
tools.description: Have several models take turns discussing a topic.

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Collect answers from a job that was still running.

tools.name: configure_keys
tools.description: Open a page in your browser to add or remove API keys.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key
anthropic_api_key.description: Optional. For Claude models through the Anthropic API (console.anthropic.com).

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Optional. For GPT models through the OpenAI API (platform.openai.com).

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Optional. One key for hundreds of models from many labs (openrouter.ai/keys).

default_models.title: Default models
default_models.description: Optional. Models to ask when none are named, as provider:model ids separated by commas, e.g. anthropic:claude-opus-5-5, openai:gpt-5
